title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
title_zh: Active-SWE：无 Issue Report 场景下主动修复 Bug 的 Coding Agent 基准
abstract_en: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs without report guidance, covering 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages. Beyond shifting the focus from existing reactive bug fixing to proactive bug fixing, Active-SWE enables a more in-depth evaluation by expanding the scope from fixing a specific recorded bug to multiple-bug fixing and potential bug discovery scenarios. To construct Active-SWE, we propose a novel difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline with a dual-track evaluation framework, facilitating comprehensive evaluation of proactive bug-fixing capability. Extensive experiments reveal that most state-of-the-art coding agents struggle with proactive bug-fixing tasks, demonstrating limited performance in locating and resolving recorded bugs, handling multiple bug fixing scenarios, and discovering valid potential bugs.
abstract_zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的 Coding Agent 正在软件工程（SWE）场景中被广泛采用，已能在大型代码库中修复特定 Bug。然而，现有 SWE 基准通常默认存在高质量、信息充分的 Issue Report，这一假设在实际中并不稳固，因为报告获取与整理成本高且复杂。为此，论文提出 Active-SWE：一个评估 Coding Agent 在无报告引导下主动发现并修复多个 Bug 能力的基准，覆盖 6 类 Bug、8 种编程语言，共 1,663 个任务。Active-SWE 将评测重点从被动修复已报告 Bug 转向主动修复 Bug，并进一步扩展到多 Bug 修复与潜在 Bug 发现。论文设计了难度感知的任务构建流程，以及双轨评测框架，以更全面衡量主动 Bug 修复能力。大量实验表明，当前多数最先进 Coding Agent 在主动 Bug 修复任务上表现有限，尤其在定位与修复已记录 Bug、处理多 Bug 场景，以及发现有效潜在 Bug 方面仍面临显著挑战。
key_points_zh: 提出 Active-SWE，面向无 Issue Report 引导的主动 Bug 发现与修复评测，区别于传统被动式 SWE 基准。
基准包含 1,663 个任务，覆盖 6 类 Bug 与 8 种编程语言，支持更贴近真实开发环境的评估。
任务范围从修复单个已记录 Bug 扩展到多 Bug 修复和潜在 Bug 发现，提升评测深度与复杂度。
构建了难度感知的任务生成流程与双轨评测框架，用于系统衡量 Coding Agent 的主动修复能力。
实验显示，当前 state-of-the-art Coding Agent 在 Bug 定位、修复、多 Bug 处理和潜在 Bug 发现上仍显著不足。

llm_assessment.comment: A clearly in-scope coding-agent benchmark that broadens evaluation to proactive bug discovery and multi-bug fixing.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项明确属于领域内的编码智能体基准，将评测扩展到主动缺陷发现和多缺陷修复。
